text:
Anna: Thanks for joining the all-hands Q&A follow-up thread — quick recap and asks from leadership: can folks drop short notes on why we won or lost deals mentioned today and any concrete asks for the roadmap? cc @Mike @Priya :wave
Mike: From post-demo notes: the deal we lost to CompetitorX boiled down to two things: integration examples were thin, and their default latency numbers looked better in the prospect's load tests. Pricing packaging (token bundles) also didn't align with their procurement flow. We have a short postmortem draft.
Priya: AE perspective: several enterprise buyers asked for an on-prem/VPC deployment timeline and stronger per-route observability. They also wanted clearer migration docs for switching models mid-rollout.
Devon: Engineering: technical root cause for the reranking pilot performance gap was batching + cold KV cache behavior — test infra p99 ~60ms, prod p99 ~220ms under realistic traffic. Proposed mitigations: smaller batch window and KV warmup for heavy tenants. Quick config diff: ```
service.runtime.batch_window_ms: 5 -> 2
enable_kv_warmup: true
```
Sarah: Wins we heard: the startup that picked us highlighted predictable dedicated capacity and the caching suggestions from Optimize. They liked the demo that showed tracing per-route latency.
James: Actionable list (short):
1) Docs: integration examples + model-switching guide — owner: Priya
2) Perf audit + canary for batching/KV warmup — owner: Devon
3) Pricing pilot for token bundles / metered trial offer — owner: Mike
4) Backlog item: per-route observability + post-trial survey — owner: Sarah
Anna: I'll fold these into the roadmap and ping leadership for prioritization. Priya — can you paste two short customer quotes we can attach to the backlog items? Also can Engineering do a small canary next week for the batching change? :eyes: @Devon
Priya: :thumbsup: I have two quotes from the AE thread, will add them here and to the ticket. Also suggestion: offer a 4–6 week metered trial instead of an upfront commit for a few prospects.
Devon: We can run a canary. Plan: 3-node canary pool + feature flag rollout. Example canary config: ```patch
- service.runtime.batch_window_ms: 5
+ service.runtime.batch_window_ms: 2
+ enable_kv_warmup: true
```
Mike: I'll own the pricing pilot. Leadership ask: can we approve a $20k credit for a high-velocity trial account? This helps get signal quickly. cc @Anna
Anna: Approved — Finance gave a provisional OK with a 6-week evaluation window. I'll post the OK in #sales and add the terms to the pilot ticket.
James: Small product ask: add a 3-question post-trial survey (one NPS, two short causes for choosing/leaving) so we can capture structured reasons. Low friction.
Devon: SGTM — we'll add a callback in onboarding to trigger the survey at trial end.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for batching patch scheduled for 2026-06-12 02:00 UTC.
Anna: Thanks everyone — I'll compile notes and publish a short follow-up doc with owners and deadlines. If anyone else heard distinct customer asks during the all-hands, drop them here and I'll slot them into the backlog.
